# Test fixtures

`codocbench_mini.jsonl` contains 6 records copied verbatim from the CoDocBench **train** split. It is generated by `scripts/make_fixture.py`.

CoDocBench: Pai, Devanbu and Ahmed, *CoDocBench: A Dataset for Code-Documentation Alignment in Software Maintenance*, MSR 2025. https://github.com/kunpai/codocbench. Licensed **CC BY 4.0** (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14251623).

No test-split records may ever be placed here (D-010).w
